newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hutchison signs Xiamen port agreement.
newsitem.headline: Hutchison signs Xiamen port agreement.

text.p: Hutchison Port Holdings, the terminal operator of Hutchison Whampoa Ltd, said it has signed an agreement to develop the Haicang Port in China's Xiamen city with Xiamen Haicang Port Services Ltd.
The project involves building and operating two berths in the deep water port including one container vessel berth and one multipurpose berth.
The company said the agreement was signed by its subsidiary Hutchison Delta Port but it did not give further details.
A Chinese source said total investment of the project was 800 million yuan and Hutchison would paY US$47 million.

Hutchison would hold 49 percent interest in the project while the remaining 51 percent would be shared by its Chinese partners, Haicang Investment Corp, Xiamen Port Services Ltd and Xiamen International Trading Corp, the source said.
The container berth would have an annual capacity of 10,000 TEUs while the multipurpose berth could serve cargo ships of up to 20,000 tonnes.
The berths were expected to be operational in the first half of 1997 the earliest, it said.
